text:
priya: quick question — we're designing the "region chooser" service for hosted API. goal: pick region by latency but respect customer tier affinity + quota. thinking: latency-first for standard, region-affinity for enterprise. any concerns?

danny: SGTM. main gotcha is stale probe state — if probes miss a region for 30s we may keep routing there. need a TTL + degrade strategy.

tom: agreed. also watch oscillation when latencies bounce. hysteresis or probe-weight smoothing helps.

carla: +1. also surface per-region quota/burst in console. if enterprise pinned to eu-west but quota exhausted -> fallback path must be explicit in UI/telemetry.

priya: proposal: policy config (very rough):
```json
{"policy":"latency_pref","probe_interval_ms":500,"stale_ttl_ms":120000,"tier_routes":{"enterprise":"region_affinity","standard":"latency_pref"}}
```
thoughts on values?

danny: probe_interval 500ms fine for p99-sensitive routes but expensive at scale. maybe sample only a % of requests for probing (1-5%) and maintain passive metrics for the rest. stale_ttl 2m seems OK.

priya: good call on sampling. how do we score region vs variant fallback? e.g., prefer local low-cost quantized model vs cross-region full model.

tom: propose simple scorer: score = latency_ms * alpha + cost_penalty + tier_penalty. lower is better. fallback if best_score > threshold. pseudocode: 
```
score(region, model) = rtt(region) * 1.0 + model.cost * 100 + (tier=="enterprise"? -50 : 0)
if score(best) > 2000: fallbackToRemoteOrSmallerModel()
```

carla: add metrics before/after: routing.choice, probe.rtt_hist, fallback.count, model.variant_used. we should expose per-customer routing decision log to the console for troubleshooting.

priya: dashboard link prototype: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/route-decider — will add a chart for "fallback.count by region" and a heatmap for "probe.rtt".

danny: rollout UX: need canary percent + automatic rollback on fallback spike. example CLI: `redwood route set region-decider --policy latency_pref --canary 5% --rollback-if "fallback.count>10/min"`

deploy-bot: deploy: region-decider/v2 -> staging at 2024-05-11T18:03:21Z :rocket: (link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4321)

tom: I'll add unit tests for scoring and a chaos test that blackholes eu-west to validate fallback.

priya: thanks — I'll update the config schema in the spec and add console mocks. tagging follow-ups: @danny for sampling strategy, @carla for telemetry + dashboard tiles. :thumbsup:
